name: Jellyfin
title: jellyfin.org
shortDescription: Jellyfin is a free software media system that allows users to manage and stream their media collections from their own servers. It supports various media types like movies, music, TV shows, and books. Users can enjoy their content on any device, ensuring a personalized media experience. Ideal for those who prefer to host their own media server and have full control over their privacy and media management.
pros: No cost to use and fully open source
cons: Requires technical knowledge to set up
